verdicts.reason: A: the can is shrunk to a tiny shape floating high in the top-left, out of line with the quote block. The large quote mark sits far above the copy, so the left and right halves read as unrelated fragments with dead space under the can. B: the can is larger and its top lines up with the quote, which gives a clearer two-column banner. However, the quote mark is tiny, the attribution is jammed directly under the last quote line, and the quote text runs almost to the right edge.
